title: Model-space LAYOUT group-331 VPORT target audit
mode: Primary-source documentation review, diagnostic-only AC1024 trace, and validated generated fast implementation slice
scope: Determine whether the layout graph preflight's assumption that every non-null LAYOUT group-331 reference targets a paper-space VIEWPORT applies to the model layout.
Correlate ODA and Autodesk field descriptions, open-source layout documentation, and a local trace without weakening paper-space owner checks.
Add an implementation-ready local fix slice under the existing PAR-49/7G.3 plan owner while preserving the fast-test cadence and external evidence limits.

sources.name: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1
sources.observed: The LAYOUT object field list describes group 330 as the associated paperspace BLOCK_RECORD soft pointer and group 331 as the last-active viewport soft pointer; R2004+ separately stores viewport count and a repeated viewport-handle list.
sources.limits: The inspected field description does not identify one target class for group 331 across model and paper layouts. ODA v5.4.1 remains the authoritative DWG byte-layout reference; this pass did not edit DWG parsing.

sources.name: Autodesk LAYOUT DXF reference
sources.observed: The DXF table describes group 331 as the ID/handle to the viewport last active in the layout when the layout was current.
sources.limits: The table does not specify a universal runtime target class for every layout type.

sources.name: ezdxf layout-management documentation
sources.observed: The documentation states that the modelspace layout requires (?) a VPORT entity in the VPORT table at group code 331; it separately describes a main VIEWPORT entity for paperspace layouts.
sources.limits: The question mark signals uncertainty in this peer documentation. It is corroboration for a narrow profile-specific candidate, not normative authority or proof of general interoperability.

sources.name: Local layout graph validator and generated controls
sources.observed: validateLayoutGraph()'s hasOwnedViewport lambda searches retained entity containers and requires a DRW_Viewport with paperspace status and layout-owner consistency. The existing layout-graph selector tests the paper-space VIEWPORT route but does not set the Model LAYOUT's lastActiveViewportHandle to a VPORT table record.
sources.limits: This is source evidence for the rejection path, not a corrected implementation or a completed regression test.

sources.name: Diagnostic-only local AC1024 trace
sources.observed: The trace logs VPORT handle 0x94 (decimal 148), reports Model LAYOUT handle 34, and then rejects LAYOUT 331 because handle 148 does not resolve to a retained entity. The read observation reports operationSucceeded=true, semanticCoverage=partial-observed, 663 observed and published frames, zero entity/object parse failures, and 14 skipped unsupported associative-class instances.
sources.limits: The sample provenance was not independently established. The file was read in place, not copied or modified, and is not proposed as a fixture. Explicit partial mode does not weaken owner/reference validation; this failure does not show that strict conversion should accept the partial input. Output and trace were written under a disposable system temporary directory.

assessment.implementationOrderChanged: Adds the model-layout group-331 case as the next bounded 7G.3 local follow-up; does not reorder unrelated work or composed external/native checkpoints.

planChanges: Added PAR-142 for the locally observed model-layout group-331 target-class false rejection, with its exact validator path and evidence limits.
Specified a narrow positive route only when normalized Model layout identity and reciprocal *MODEL_SPACE BLOCK_RECORD identity agree; resolve nonzero 331 to one unique DRW_Vport by handle.
Preserved paper-layout VIEWPORT owner checks, the current-paper-space ownerless DWG exception, atomic output refusal, and strict-versus-partial DWG-read policy.
Added generated ASCII/Binary positive and wrong-target negative controls to the existing layout-graph selector, without a new fixture or mandatory full-suite/peer/native run.
Implemented the narrow reciprocal Model/*MODEL_SPACE to unique VPORT resolver; paper-layout VIEWPORT ownership validation remains unchanged.
Updated DXF VPORT serialization to register emitted handles for valid source VPORT handles, preserving Model LAYOUT 331 through remapping.
Verified focused selector, owning CTest, scoped warning-as-error builds, and diff checks; slice remains uncommitted because the shared worktree has extensive unrelated overlapping changes.
Kept the sample diagnostic-only, uncommitted, and non-promoting; documented the unresolved later associative/SUN graph failures and self-unblocking next step.

validation: Local source review confirmed that the validator currently only resolves group 331 through entity containers as paper-space DRW_Viewport records.
A single AC1024 diagnostic conversion with explicit partial mode reproduced the class mismatch at export preflight.
Official ODA and Autodesk documentation plus ezdxf's qualified modelspace note were reviewed; no target-class rule was generalized from the peer source alone.
cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_dxf_fixture_tests dwg2dxf --parallel 2 passed with -Werror.
build-gcc/libdxfrw_dxf_fixture_tests --layout-graph-read-contract passed for generated ASCII and Binary controls.
git diff --check passed for the implementation, test, plan, and receipt files.

limitations: The AC1024 input is partial-observed and has 14 skipped unsupported associative-class instances; resolving PAR-142 alone cannot promote conversion completeness.
Autodesk and ODA publish the group-331 role but do not state an invariant target class covering all layout types in the inspected passages.
The ezdxf modelspace statement is qualified with '(?)' and is corroborative, not normative.

The new controls and production correction are validated only by generated local ASCII/Binary DXF and the owning test; no external producer, native CAD consumer, Linux/Windows consumer, or independent geometry semantics were exercised.
The slice remains uncommitted because extensive unrelated changes already occupy the shared worktree and overlap the touched source/test files.
No external/native semantic evidence was gathered; J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
